name: M3_CPS100MI_SelTotalLoad
description: Retrieve the total pegged load for a single work center in a facility over a specified period. The operation returns one record per calendar year/week and work center, including organizational identifiers (company, facility, work center, department, planning area) and the calendar period. For each period it provides the rated capacity per unit and shift, plus a detailed breakdown of man‑time and machine‑time load from different sources: planned orders, manufacturing orders, work orders, service orders, and project activities, separated into load categories (A/B/C where applicable). The aggregated data supports capacity planning and analysis of over‑ and under‑load, for example when feeding Capacity Planning Workbench or other planning tools.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility for which the work center load is selected.

inputParameters.name: PLGR
inputParameters.description: Work center whose total load is selected.

inputParameters.name: FRDT
inputParameters.description: Start date of the period for which work center load is retrieved. Must be earlier than To date; if both dates are blank, only records for the current calendar year are returned.

inputParameters.name: TODT
inputParameters.description: End date of the period for which work center load is retrieved. Must be later than From date; if both dates are blank, only records for the current calendar year are returned.

inputParameters.name: MOHL
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether manufacturing orders on hold (status X5) are included in the selected load.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility to which the work center belongs.

outputParameters.name: PLGR
outputParameters.description: Work center for which the total load is reported.

outputParameters.name: CYW6
outputParameters.description: Year and week for which the total load values are aggregated.

outputParameters.name: DEPT
outputParameters.description: Department associated with the work center for this load bucket.

outputParameters.name: REAR
outputParameters.description: Planning area between work center and department used for summarizing load.

outputParameters.name: CPTY
outputParameters.description: Rated capacity per resource unit and shift for the work center.

outputParameters.name: PMEA
outputParameters.description: Total man-hours in load category A from planned orders in the period (group 1).

outputParameters.name: PMAA
outputParameters.description: Total machine-hours in load category A from planned orders in the period (group 1).

outputParameters.name: PMEB
outputParameters.description: Total man-hours in load category B from planned orders in the period (group 1).

outputParameters.name: PMAB
outputParameters.description: Total machine-hours in load category B from planned orders in the period (group 1).

outputParameters.name: MMEA
outputParameters.description: Total man-hours in load category A from manufacturing orders in the period.

outputParameters.name: MMAA
outputParameters.description: Total machine-hours in load category A from manufacturing orders in the period.

outputParameters.name: MMEB
outputParameters.description: Total man-hours in load category B from manufacturing orders in the period.

outputParameters.name: MMAB
outputParameters.description: Total machine-hours in load category B from manufacturing orders in the period.

outputParameters.name: PWEA
outputParameters.description: Total man-hours in load category A from planned orders in the period (group 2).

outputParameters.name: PWAA
outputParameters.description: Total machine-hours in load category A from planned orders in the period (group 2).

outputParameters.name: PWEB
outputParameters.description: Total man-hours in load category B from planned orders in the period (group 2).

outputParameters.name: PWAB
outputParameters.description: Total machine-hours in load category B from planned orders in the period (group 2).

outputParameters.name: MWEA
outputParameters.description: Total man-hours in load category A from work orders in the period.

outputParameters.name: MWAA
outputParameters.description: Total machine-hours in load category A from work orders in the period.

outputParameters.name: MWEB
outputParameters.description: Total man-hours in load category B from work orders in the period.

outputParameters.name: MWAB
outputParameters.description: Total machine-hours in load category B from work orders in the period.

outputParameters.name: JWEA
outputParameters.description: Total man-hours in load category A from project-related work in the period.

outputParameters.name: MOHD
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the manufacturing order is on hold.

outputParameters.name: MOHL
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether held manufacturing orders were included in this load calculation.

outputParameters.name: SWEA
outputParameters.description: Total man-hours in load category A from service orders in the period.

outputParameters.name: SWEB
outputParameters.description: Total man-hours in load category B from service orders in the period.

outputParameters.name: SWEC
outputParameters.description: Total man-hours in load category C from service orders in the period.

outputParameters.name: LMTS
outputParameters.description: Timestamp of the last update of this load record.
